module
public import Eggshell.OrderedIncidence
@[expose] public section
namespace Eggshell.Research.FactoredIncidence

variable {U C A : Type} [BEq C] [LawfulBEq C] [Hashable C]

/-- Immutable structural incidence. There is no question, weight, query budget,
or completion authority here. The caller supplies full scoped coordinate keys. -/
structure Static (keys : U → List C) (units : List U) where
  incidence : OrderedIncidence.Index keys units

def compile (keys : U → List C) (units : List U) : Static keys units :=
  ⟨OrderedIncidence.build keys units⟩

def Static.neighbors {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (coordinate : C) : List U :=
  ready.incidence.lookup coordinate

theorem Static.member {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (coordinate : C) (unit : U) :
    unit ∈ ready.neighbors coordinate ↔ unit ∈ units ∧ coordinate ∈ keys unit := by
  rw [Static.neighbors,OrderedIncidence.Index.lookup_exact]
  simp

/-- Only the new unit rows are processed. Persistent map paths may be copied;
old coordinates are not decoded or re-enumerated. Old readers retain old data. -/
def Static.extend {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (next : List U) : Static keys (units++next) :=
  ⟨⟨next.foldl (OrderedIncidence.add keys) ready.incidence.table,by
    intro coordinate
    have step := OrderedIncidence.fold_lookup keys next ready.incidence.table coordinate
    have reversed := congrArg List.reverse step
    simpa only [List.reverse_append,List.reverse_reverse,ready.incidence.exact,List.filter_append] using reversed⟩⟩

theorem Static.extended_lookup {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (next : List U) (coordinate : C) :
    (ready.extend next).neighbors coordinate =
      ready.neighbors coordinate ++ (compile keys next).neighbors coordinate := by
  simp only [Static.neighbors,OrderedIncidence.Index.lookup_exact,List.filter_append]

variable [BEq U] [LawfulBEq U] [Hashable U]

structure Request (C A : Type) where
  coordinate : C
  active : Bool
  value : A
  deriving BEq

def requestKeys {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (request : Request C A) : List U :=
  if request.active then ready.neighbors request.coordinate else []

/-- Transpose the active structural hits once, in original request order.
Repeated requests remain repeated rows. Repeated structural witnesses do not
manufacture duplicate votes for one request. -/
def project {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (requests : List (Request C A)) :
    OrderedIncidence.Index (requestKeys ready) requests :=
  OrderedIncidence.build (requestKeys ready) requests

def accepts (keys : U → List C) (units : List U) (unit : U)
    (request : Request C A) : Bool :=
  request.active && decide (unit ∈ units) && decide (request.coordinate ∈ keys unit)

omit [Hashable U] in
theorem request_key_exact {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (request : Request C A) (unit : U) :
    decide (unit ∈ requestKeys ready request) = accepts keys units unit request := by
  cases active : request.active <;> simp [requestKeys,active,accepts,Static.member]

/-- Full ordered equality, including payloads, inactive rows and duplicates.
This is a relation-level theorem, not yet a proof that a product's coordinate
catalogue completely represents all of its interval-containment predicates. -/
theorem project_exact {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (requests : List (Request C A)) (unit : U) :
    (project ready requests).lookup unit = requests.filter (accepts keys units unit) := by
  rw [OrderedIncidence.Index.lookup_exact]
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro request _
  exact request_key_exact ready request unit

theorem payloads_exact {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (requests : List (Request C A)) (unit : U) :
    ((project ready requests).lookup unit).map Request.value =
      (requests.filter (accepts keys units unit)).map Request.value := by
  rw [project_exact]

def reference (keys : U → List C) (units : List U) (requests : List (Request C A)) (unit : U) :
    List (Request C A) :=
  if unit ∈ units then
    let coordinates := keys unit
    requests.filter (fun row => row.active && decide (row.coordinate ∈ coordinates))
  else []

omit [Hashable C] [Hashable U] in
theorem reference_exact (keys : U → List C) (units : List U) (requests : List (Request C A)) (unit : U) :
    reference keys units requests unit = requests.filter (accepts keys units unit) := by
  by_cases present : unit ∈ units
  · rw [reference,if_pos present]
    apply List.filter_congr
    intro request _
    simp [accepts,present]
  · have inactive : accepts keys units unit = (fun _ : Request C A => false) := by
      funext request
      simp [accepts,present]
    simp [reference,present,inactive]

theorem lookup_reference {keys : U → List C} {units : List U}
    (ready : Static keys units) (requests : List (Request C A)) (unit : U) :
    (project ready requests).lookup unit = reference keys units requests unit := by
  rw [project_exact,reference_exact]

#print axioms Static.extended_lookup
#print axioms project_exact
#print axioms lookup_reference

end Eggshell.Research.FactoredIncidence

module
public import tools.research.FactoredIncidence
@[expose] public section
namespace Eggshell.Research.RangeIncidence

/-- Scalar source coordinates work for files, JSON and opaque tool output.
The scope key is supplied by the checked snapshot, never inferred from a tool
name. No catalogue of future query endpoints is required. -/
structure Row (S U : Type) where
  scope : S
  first : Nat
  last : Nat
  unit : U
  deriving BEq

def contains (row : Row S U) (first last : Nat) : Bool :=
  row.first ≤ first && last ≤ row.last

inductive Tree (S U : Type) where
  | leaf (row : Row S U)
  | branch (lower upper : Nat) (left right : Tree S U)

def Tree.lower : Tree S U → Nat
  | .leaf row => row.first
  | .branch lower _ _ _ => lower

def Tree.upper : Tree S U → Nat
  | .leaf row => row.last
  | .branch _ upper _ _ => upper

def Tree.rows : Tree S U → List (Row S U)
  | .leaf row => [row]
  | .branch _ _ left right => left.rows ++ right.rows

def Tree.Valid : Tree S U → Prop
  | .leaf _ => True
  | .branch lower upper left right =>
    left.Valid ∧ right.Valid ∧ lower ≤ left.lower ∧ lower ≤ right.lower ∧
      left.upper ≤ upper ∧ right.upper ≤ upper

theorem Tree.bounds (tree : Tree S U) (valid : tree.Valid)
    (row : Row S U) (present : row ∈ tree.rows) :
    tree.lower ≤ row.first ∧ row.last ≤ tree.upper := by
  induction tree with
  | leaf item =>
    have same : row = item := by simpa [rows] using present
    subst row
    exact ⟨Nat.le_refl _,Nat.le_refl _⟩
  | branch lower upper left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    rcases valid with ⟨vl,vr,ll,lr,ul,ur⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.mp present with hit | hit
    · have := ihLeft vl hit; simp only [Tree.lower,Tree.upper]; omega
    · have := ihRight vr hit; simp only [Tree.lower,Tree.upper]; omega

/-- Exact dominance lookup, including the old predicate's empty/reversed spans.
Bounds only prune impossible subtrees; they never estimate relevance. -/
def Tree.query (tree : Tree S U) (first last : Nat) : List (Row S U) :=
  if tree.lower > first || tree.upper < last then [] else
    match tree with
    | .leaf row => if contains row first last then [row] else []
    | .branch _ _ left right => left.query first last ++ right.query first last

theorem Tree.query_exact (tree : Tree S U) (valid : tree.Valid) (first last : Nat) :
    tree.query first last = tree.rows.filter (contains · first last) := by
  induction tree with
  | leaf row =>
    by_cases fit : contains row first last = true
    · have limits : row.first ≤ first ∧ last ≤ row.last := by simpa [contains] using fit
      simp [query,lower,upper,rows,fit,Nat.not_lt.mpr limits.1,Nat.not_lt.mpr limits.2]
    · have reject : contains row first last = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr fit
      simp [query,lower,upper,rows,reject]
  | branch lower upper left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    unfold query
    split
    · rename_i outside
      symm
      apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr
      intro row present
      have limits := Tree.bounds (.branch lower upper left right) valid row present
      simp only [Tree.lower,Tree.upper] at limits
      have outside' : lower > first ∨ upper < last := by
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mp outside with hit | hit
        · exact Or.inl (of_decide_eq_true hit)
        · exact Or.inr (of_decide_eq_true hit)
      intro accepted
      have matched : row.first ≤ first ∧ last ≤ row.last := by simpa [contains] using accepted
      omega
    · simp only [rows,List.filter_append]
      rw [ihLeft valid.1,ihRight valid.2.1]

structure Index (S U : Type) where
  tree : Tree S U
  valid : tree.Valid

def Index.leaf (row : Row S U) : Index S U := ⟨.leaf row,True.intro⟩

def Index.join (left right : Index S U) : Index S U :=
  ⟨.branch (min left.tree.lower right.tree.lower) (max left.tree.upper right.tree.upper)
    left.tree right.tree,by
    exact ⟨left.valid,right.valid,Nat.min_le_left _ _,Nat.min_le_right _ _,
      Nat.le_max_left _ _,Nat.le_max_right _ _⟩⟩

def combine (left right : Option (Index S U)) : Option (Index S U) :=
  match left,right with
  | none,other | other,none => other
  | some left,some right => some (left.join right)

def allRows (index : Option (Index S U)) : List (Row S U) :=
  match index with | none => [] | some ready => ready.tree.rows

theorem combine_rows (left right : Option (Index S U)) :
    allRows (combine left right) = allRows left ++ allRows right := by
  cases left <;> cases right <;> simp [combine,allRows,Index.join,Tree.rows]

/-- Publication-only construction. Sorted first endpoints make the bounds
useful; balancing preserves original order and does not affect correctness. -/
def build (rows : List (Row S U)) : Option (Index S U) :=
  if small : rows.length ≤ 1 then
    match rows with | [] => none | row::_ => some (Index.leaf row)
  else combine (build (rows.take (rows.length/2))) (build (rows.drop (rows.length/2)))
termination_by rows.length
decreasing_by
  · simp only [List.length_take]
    have := Nat.div_lt_self (show 0 < rows.length by omega) (show 1 < 2 by omega)
    omega
  · simp only [List.length_drop]
    have := Nat.div_pos (show 2 ≤ rows.length by omega) (show 0 < 2 by omega)
    omega

theorem build_rows (rows : List (Row S U)) : allRows (build rows) = rows := by
  unfold build
  split
  · rename_i small
    match rows with
    | [] => rfl
    | [row] => rfl
    | _::_::_ => simp at small
  · rw [combine_rows,build_rows,build_rows,List.take_append_drop]
termination_by rows.length
decreasing_by
  · simp only [List.length_take]
    have := Nat.div_lt_self (show 0 < rows.length by omega) (show 1 < 2 by omega)
    omega
  · simp only [List.length_drop]
    have := Nat.div_pos (show 2 ≤ rows.length by omega) (show 0 < 2 by omega)
    omega

def lookup (ready : Option (Index S U)) (first last : Nat) : List (Row S U) :=
  match ready with | none => [] | some ready => ready.tree.query first last

theorem lookup_exact (ready : Option (Index S U)) (first last : Nat) :
    lookup ready first last = (allRows ready).filter (contains · first last) := by
  cases ready with
  | none => rfl
  | some ready => exact ready.tree.query_exact ready.valid first last

variable [BEq S] [LawfulBEq S] [Hashable S]

/-- A project snapshot supplies full scope keys (including DB/source identity).
The table contains immutable trees, not per-chat weights or mutable workers. -/
structure Scoped (rows : List (Row S U)) where
  table : Std.HashMap S (Option (Index S U))
  exact : ∀ scope, allRows (table.getD scope none) = rows.filter (scope == ·.scope)

def prepare (rows : List (Row S U)) : Scoped rows :=
  let groups := Eggshell.OrderedIncidence.build (fun row : Row S U => [row.scope]) rows
  ⟨groups.table.map (fun _ reversed => build reversed.reverse),by
    intro scope
    have ordered := groups.lookup_exact scope
    simp only [Eggshell.OrderedIncidence.Index.lookup] at ordered
    rw [Std.HashMap.getD_eq_getD_getElem?] at ordered
    simp only [Std.HashMap.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,Std.HashMap.getElem?_map]
    cases found : groups.table[scope]? with
    | none => simpa [found,allRows] using ordered
    | some items => simpa [found,build_rows] using ordered⟩

def Scoped.query {rows : List (Row S U)} (ready : Scoped rows) (scope : S)
    (first last : Nat) : List (Row S U) := lookup (ready.table.getD scope none) first last

omit [LawfulBEq S] in
theorem Scoped.query_exact {rows : List (Row S U)} (ready : Scoped rows) (scope : S)
    (first last : Nat) : ready.query scope first last =
      rows.filter (fun row => scope == row.scope && contains row first last) := by
  rw [Scoped.query,lookup_exact,ready.exact,List.filter_filter]
  simp only [Bool.and_comm]

/-- A resolver is exact for every coordinate, including endpoints absent at
publication. A geometry producer must establish this stronger contract. -/
structure Resolver (U C : Type) (related : U → C → Bool) where
  neighbors : C → List U
  exact : ∀ coordinate unit,unit ∈ neighbors coordinate ↔ related unit coordinate = true

variable [BEq U] [LawfulBEq U] [Hashable U]

def Resolver.project {related : U → C → Bool} (ready : Resolver U C related)
    (requests : List (Eggshell.Research.FactoredIncidence.Request C A)) :=
  Eggshell.OrderedIncidence.build
    (fun request => if request.active then ready.neighbors request.coordinate else []) requests

theorem Resolver.project_exact {related : U → C → Bool} (ready : Resolver U C related)
    (requests : List (Eggshell.Research.FactoredIncidence.Request C A)) (unit : U) :
    (ready.project requests).lookup unit =
      requests.filter (fun request => request.active && related unit request.coordinate) := by
  rw [Eggshell.OrderedIncidence.Index.lookup_exact]
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro request _
  cases request.active <;> simp [ready.exact]

structure Coordinate (S : Type) where
  scope : S
  first : Nat
  last : Nat
  deriving BEq

def related (rows : List (Row S U)) (unit : U) (coordinate : Coordinate S) : Bool :=
  rows.any fun row => coordinate.scope == row.scope && row.unit == unit &&
    contains row coordinate.first coordinate.last

/-- Sorting changes only structural witness order. Projection below restores
the original request order and retains every duplicate request. -/
def resolve (rows : List (Row S U)) : Resolver U (Coordinate S) (related rows) :=
  let sorted := rows.mergeSort (fun a b => a.first ≤ b.first)
  let index := prepare sorted
  ⟨(fun coordinate => (index.query coordinate.scope coordinate.first coordinate.last).map Row.unit),by
    intro coordinate unit
    rw [Scoped.query_exact,List.mem_map]
    simp only [List.mem_filter,sorted,List.mem_mergeSort,related,List.any_eq_true]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨row,⟨present,hit⟩,same⟩
      refine ⟨row,present,?_⟩
      simpa [same,Bool.and_assoc] using hit
    · rintro ⟨row,present,hit⟩
      have split := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hit
      have same : row.unit = unit := beq_iff_eq.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp split.1).2
      refine ⟨row,⟨present,?_⟩,same⟩
      exact Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr ⟨(Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp split.1).1,split.2⟩⟩

def rowsFor (units : List U) (scope : U → S) (ranges : U → List (Nat × Nat)) : List (Row S U) :=
  units.flatMap fun unit => (ranges unit).map fun (first,last) => ⟨scope unit,first,last,unit⟩

/-- The actual base-range predicate, rather than equality on a finite sample
of observed coordinates. This includes empty and reversed ranges verbatim. -/
def baseAccept (units : List U) (scope : U → S) (ranges : U → List (Nat × Nat))
    (unit : U) (coordinate : Coordinate S) : Bool :=
  decide (unit ∈ units) && coordinate.scope == scope unit &&
    (ranges unit).any (fun (first,last) => first ≤ coordinate.first && coordinate.last ≤ last)

omit [Hashable S] [Hashable U] in
theorem rowsFor_related (units : List U) (scope : U → S) (ranges : U → List (Nat × Nat))
    (unit : U) (coordinate : Coordinate S) :
    related (rowsFor units scope ranges) unit coordinate = baseAccept units scope ranges unit coordinate := by
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [related,rowsFor,List.any_eq_true,List.mem_flatMap,List.mem_map,baseAccept,
    Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq,beq_iff_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨row,⟨owner,present,pair,pairPresent,same⟩,⟨sameScope,sameUnit⟩,inside⟩
    cases same
    change owner = unit at sameUnit
    subst owner
    exact ⟨⟨present,sameScope⟩,pair,pairPresent,by simpa [contains] using inside⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨present,sameScope⟩,pair,pairPresent,inside⟩
    refine ⟨⟨scope unit,pair.1,pair.2,unit⟩,⟨unit,present,pair,pairPresent,rfl⟩,⟨sameScope,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simpa [contains] using inside

def resolveBase (units : List U) (scope : U → S) (ranges : U → List (Nat × Nat)) :
    Resolver U (Coordinate S) (baseAccept units scope ranges) :=
  let ready := resolve (rowsFor units scope ranges)
  ⟨ready.neighbors,by intro coordinate unit; rw [ready.exact,rowsFor_related]⟩

theorem resolveBase_exact (units : List U) (scope : U → S) (ranges : U → List (Nat × Nat))
    (requests : List (Eggshell.Research.FactoredIncidence.Request (Coordinate S) A)) (unit : U) :
    ((resolveBase units scope ranges).project requests).lookup unit =
      requests.filter (fun request => request.active && baseAccept units scope ranges unit request.coordinate) :=
  Resolver.project_exact _ _ _

/-- An over-approximating structural lookup may be refined with the original
predicate. The completeness obligation prevents silently missing a span
which is covered by a union but not by any one constituent interval. -/
def Resolver.refine {related : U → C → Bool} (ready : Resolver U C related)
    (accept : U → C → Bool) (complete : ∀ unit coordinate,
      accept unit coordinate = true → related unit coordinate = true) : Resolver U C accept :=
  ⟨(fun coordinate => (ready.neighbors coordinate).filter (accept · coordinate)),by
    intro coordinate unit
    rw [List.mem_filter,ready.exact]
    exact ⟨And.right,fun hit => ⟨complete unit coordinate hit,hit⟩⟩⟩

def Resolver.comap {related : U → C → Bool} (ready : Resolver U C related) (f : D → C) :
    Resolver U D (fun unit input => related unit (f input)) :=
  ⟨(fun input => ready.neighbors (f input)),fun input unit => ready.exact (f input) unit⟩

structure Forward (related : U → C → Bool) (requests : List (FactoredIncidence.Request C A)) where
  table : Std.HashMap U (List (FactoredIncidence.Request C A))
  exact : ∀ unit,table.getD unit [] = requests.filter (fun request => request.active && related unit request.coordinate)

/-- Each class posting is made forward once. Clients share its immutable list
without reversing or copying it for every unit in that class. -/
def Resolver.finish {related : U → C → Bool} (ready : Resolver U C related)
    (requests : List (FactoredIncidence.Request C A)) : Forward related requests :=
  let index := ready.project requests
  ⟨index.table.map (fun _ rows => rows.reverse),by
    intro unit
    have exact := ready.project_exact requests unit
    unfold OrderedIncidence.Index.lookup at exact
    change (index.table.getD unit []).reverse = _ at exact
    rw [Std.HashMap.getD_eq_getD_getElem?] at exact
    simp only [Std.HashMap.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,Std.HashMap.getElem?_map]
    cases found : index.table[unit]? with
    | none => simpa [found] using exact
    | some rows => simpa [found] using exact⟩

structure Geometry (S : Type) where
  scope : S
  ranges : List (Nat × Nat)
  deriving BEq,Hashable,ReflBEq,LawfulBEq

def Geometry.accept (geometry : Geometry S) (coordinate : Coordinate S) : Bool :=
  coordinate.scope == geometry.scope &&
    geometry.ranges.any (fun (first,last) => first ≤ coordinate.first && coordinate.last ≤ last)

/-- Full geometry equality is checked once, not equality on yesterday's query
samples. Different cost, Work, bytes and authority stay distinct unit values. -/
structure Sharing (geometry : U → Geometry S) (units : List U) where
  classOf : U → Nat
  classes : Array (Geometry S)
  admitted : ∀ unit ∈ units,classOf unit < classes.size
  same : ∀ unit (present : unit ∈ units),classes[classOf unit]'(admitted unit present) = geometry unit
  lookup : Resolver (Fin classes.size) (Coordinate S)
    (baseAccept (List.finRange classes.size) (fun group => classes[group].scope) (fun group => classes[group].ranges))

def Sharing.check (geometry : U → Geometry S) (units : List U) (classOf : U → Nat)
    (classes : Array (Geometry S)) : Option (Sharing geometry units) :=
  if valid : units.all (fun unit => decide (classOf unit < classes.size) &&
      (classes[classOf unit]?.getD (geometry unit) == geometry unit)) = true then
    let admitted : ∀ unit ∈ units,classOf unit < classes.size := by
      intro unit present
      exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (List.all_eq_true.mp valid unit present)).1
    some {
      classOf,classes,admitted
      same := by
        intro unit present
        have hit := beq_iff_eq.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (List.all_eq_true.mp valid unit present)).2
        simpa [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem (admitted unit present)] using hit
      lookup := resolveBase (List.finRange classes.size) (fun group => classes[group].scope) (fun group => classes[group].ranges) }
  else none

def Sharing.resolver {geometry : U → Geometry S} {units : List U} (ready : Sharing geometry units) :=
  ready.lookup

def Sharing.project {geometry : U → Geometry S} {units : List U} (ready : Sharing geometry units)
    (requests : List (FactoredIncidence.Request (Coordinate S) A)) := ready.resolver.finish requests

omit [LawfulBEq S] [Hashable S] [BEq U] [LawfulBEq U] [Hashable U] in
theorem Sharing.rows_exact {geometry : U → Geometry S} {units : List U} (ready : Sharing geometry units)
    (requests : List (FactoredIncidence.Request (Coordinate S) A)) (unit : U) (present : unit ∈ units) :
    (ready.project requests).table.getD ⟨ready.classOf unit,ready.admitted unit present⟩ [] =
      requests.filter (fun request => request.active && (geometry unit).accept request.coordinate) := by
  rw [Forward.exact]
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro request _
  simp only [baseAccept,List.mem_finRange,decide_true,Bool.true_and]
  change (request.active && (ready.classes[ready.classOf unit]'(ready.admitted unit present)).accept request.coordinate) = _
  rw [ready.same unit present]

#print axioms Tree.query_exact
#print axioms build_rows
#print axioms Scoped.query_exact
#print axioms Resolver.project_exact
#print axioms rowsFor_related
#print axioms resolveBase_exact
#print axioms Resolver.refine
#print axioms Sharing.rows_exact
end Eggshell.Research.RangeIncidence

module
public import tools.research.RangeIncidence
public import Eggshell.Handoff
@[expose] public section
namespace Eggshell.Research.ProductRangeIncidence
open Eggshell.Plugin Eggshell.Plugin.SharedRangeAdapter
open Eggshell.Research.RangeIncidence

/-- Families are local to this checked query view. A service may retain the
tree only with this view; persistent cross-view keys must include DB/source
identity. This bridge does not introduce a second mutable project cache. -/
def base (units : Array ServiceUnit) :=
  resolveBase (List.finRange units.size) (fun unit => units[unit].shape.family)
    (fun unit => units[unit].shape.ranges)

def baseAccept (units : Array ServiceUnit) (unit : Fin units.size) (coordinate : Coordinate Nat) : Bool :=
  coordinate.scope == units[unit].shape.family &&
    units[unit].shape.ranges.any (fun (first,last) => first ≤ coordinate.first && coordinate.last ≤ last)

theorem base_exact (units : Array ServiceUnit) (unit : Fin units.size) (coordinate : Coordinate Nat) :
    unit ∈ (base units).neighbors coordinate ↔ baseAccept units unit coordinate = true := by
  rw [Resolver.exact]
  simp [RangeIncidence.baseAccept,baseAccept]

/-- Bonus coverage is the union predicate from the existing selector. Adjacent
raw intervals cannot be replaced by a single raw-interval containment test. -/
def unionAccept (units : Array ServiceUnit) (unit : Fin units.size) (coordinate : Coordinate Nat) : Bool :=
  coordinate.scope == units[unit].shape.family &&
    units[unit].shape.coversPrepared coordinate.first coordinate.last

def firstPoint (coordinate : Coordinate Nat) : Coordinate Nat := {coordinate with last := coordinate.first}

theorem union_has_first (units : Array ServiceUnit) (unit : Fin units.size) (coordinate : Coordinate Nat)
    (covered : unionAccept units unit coordinate = true) :
    RangeIncidence.baseAccept (List.finRange units.size) (fun i => units[i].shape.family)
      (fun i => units[i].shape.ranges) unit (firstPoint coordinate) = true := by
  have pair := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp covered
  have covered := pair.2
  have ordered : coordinate.first < coordinate.last := by
    by_cases h : coordinate.first < coordinate.last
    · exact h
    · simp [UnitShape.coversPrepared,h] at covered
  have whole : covers units[unit].shape.ranges coordinate.first coordinate.last = true := by
    simpa only [UnitShape.prepared_covers_exact] using covered
  obtain ⟨span,present,inside⟩ := covers_position units[unit].shape.ranges coordinate.first coordinate.last
    coordinate.first whole ⟨Nat.le_refl _,ordered⟩
  simp only [RangeIncidence.baseAccept,firstPoint]
  apply Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr ⟨by simp,pair.1⟩,?_⟩
  apply List.any_eq_true.mpr
  refine ⟨span,present,?_⟩
  change (decide (span.1 ≤ coordinate.first) && decide (coordinate.first ≤ span.2)) = true
  simp [inside.1,Nat.le_of_lt inside.2]

def union (units : Array ServiceUnit) : Resolver (Fin units.size) (Coordinate Nat) (unionAccept units) :=
  ((base units).comap firstPoint).refine (unionAccept units) (union_has_first units)

theorem union_exact (units : Array ServiceUnit) (unit : Fin units.size) (coordinate : Coordinate Nat) :
    unit ∈ (union units).neighbors coordinate ↔ unionAccept units unit coordinate = true :=
  (union units).exact coordinate unit

/-- Every request value is kept. Repeated cues remain repeated and inactive
weights are filtered before projection, exactly as in problemFromView. -/
def requests (pieces : List (CuePiece × Nat)) := pieces.map fun entry =>
  ({coordinate := ⟨entry.1.family,entry.1.first,entry.1.last⟩,
    active := entry.1.baseWeight > 0,value := entry} : FactoredIncidence.Request (Coordinate Nat) (CuePiece × Nat))

def matching (units : Array ServiceUnit) (pieces : List (CuePiece × Nat)) (unit : Fin units.size) :=
  (((base units).project (requests pieces)).lookup unit).map FactoredIncidence.Request.value

theorem matching_exact (units : Array ServiceUnit) (pieces : List (CuePiece × Nat)) (unit : Fin units.size) :
    matching units pieces unit = pieces.filter (fun entry =>
      entry.1.baseWeight > 0 && entry.1.family == units[unit].shape.family &&
        units[unit].shape.ranges.any (fun (first,last) => first ≤ entry.1.first && entry.1.last ≤ last)) := by
  rw [matching,Resolver.project_exact]
  simp only [requests,RangeIncidence.baseAccept,List.mem_finRange,decide_true,Bool.true_and]
  induction pieces with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.filter_cons]
    simp only [Bool.and_assoc] at *
    split <;> simp_all

#print axioms base_exact
#print axioms union_exact
#print axioms matching_exact
end Eggshell.Research.ProductRangeIncidence

module
public import tools.research.ProductRangeIncidence
import Lean.Data.Json.FromToJson
@[expose] public section
open Lean Eggshell Eggshell.Research
open RangeIncidence
namespace RangeIncidenceBench
structure Scope where
  db : String
  owner : String
  fingerprint : String
  deriving BEq,Hashable,ReflBEq,LawfulBEq
abbrev Request := FactoredIncidence.Request (Coordinate Scope) (Nat × Nat)

structure Dataset where
  units : List Nat
  geometries : Array (Geometry Scope)
  sharing : Sharing (fun unit => geometries[unit]?.getD ⟨⟨"absent","",""⟩,[]⟩) units
  requests : List Request

def compileSharing (geometries : Array (Geometry Scope)) (units : List Nat) := Id.run do
  let mut ids : Std.HashMap (Geometry Scope) Nat := {}
  let mut assignments : Std.HashMap Nat Nat := {}
  let mut classes := #[]
  for unit in units do
    let geometry := geometries[unit]?.getD ⟨⟨"absent","",""⟩,[]⟩
    let id := ids[geometry]?.getD classes.size
    if id == classes.size then ids := ids.insert geometry id; classes := classes.push geometry
    assignments := assignments.insert unit id
  return Sharing.check (fun unit => geometries[unit]?.getD ⟨⟨"absent","",""⟩,[]⟩) units
    (fun unit => assignments[unit]?.getD classes.size) classes

def scope (family : Nat) : Scope := ⟨"project-"++toString (family%3),"owner-"++toString family,"checked-content"⟩

def make (scopes count width degree requestCount : Nat) : IO Dataset := do
  let units := List.range count
  let geometries := (Array.range count).map fun unit =>
    ({scope := scope (unit%scopes),ranges := (List.range degree).map fun offset =>
      let first := ((unit/scopes+offset)%width)*11
      (first,first+9)} : Geometry Scope)
  let some sharing := compileSharing geometries units | throw (IO.userError "geometry certificate rejected")
  let requests := (List.range requestCount).map fun id =>
    let first := ((id/scopes)%width)*11+3 -- not a published endpoint
    ({coordinate := ⟨scope (id%scopes),first,first+2⟩,active := id%11 != 0,
      value := (id,if id%17 == 0 then 2^384+id else id+1)} : Request)
  return ⟨units,geometries,sharing,requests⟩

@[noinline,nospecialize] def reference (input : Dataset) : Array (List Request) := Id.run do
  let byScope := OrderedIncidence.build (fun request : Request => [request.coordinate.scope]) input.requests
  return input.units.toArray.map fun unit =>
    let geometry := input.geometries[unit]?.getD ⟨⟨"absent","",""⟩,[]⟩
    (byScope.lookup geometry.scope).filter (fun request => request.active && geometry.accept request.coordinate)

@[noinline,nospecialize] def indexed (input : Dataset) : Array (List Request) :=
  let query := input.sharing.project input.requests
  input.units.attach.toArray.map fun unit =>
    query.table.getD ⟨input.sharing.classOf unit.val,input.sharing.admitted unit.val unit.property⟩ []

def measured (method : Dataset → Array (List Request)) (input : IO.Ref Dataset) : IO (Array (List Request) × Nat) := do
  let began ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let output := method (← input.get)
  let output ← (← IO.mkRef output).get
  return (output,((← IO.monoNanosNow)-began)/1000)

def check (ok : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit := unless ok do throw (IO.userError message)

def controls : IO Nat := do
  let scopes := [scope 0,scope 1,{scope 0 with db := "other-project"},{scope 0 with fingerprint := "changed"},
    ⟨"mcp-project","mcp://resource/issue","etag-snapshot"⟩]
  let spans : List (Nat × Nat) := [(0,2),(2,4),(0,4),(4,4),(7,2),(100000000000000000000,100000000000000000009)]
  let geometries := (scopes.flatMap fun scope => spans.map fun span => ({scope,ranges := [span,span]} : Geometry Scope)).toArray
  let units := List.range geometries.size
  let some sharing := compileSharing geometries units | throw (IO.userError "range controls rejected")
  let requests : List Request := scopes.flatMap fun scope =>
    ([(0,0),(1,3),(2,2),(3,1),(100000000000000000003,100000000000000000007),(100,101)]++spans).zipIdx.map fun (entry : (Nat × Nat) × Nat) =>
      let (span,id) := entry
      ({coordinate := ⟨scope,span.1,span.2⟩,active := id%3 != 0,value := (id,2^256+id)} : Request)
  let input : Dataset := ⟨units,geometries,sharing,requests++requests⟩
  check (reference input == indexed input) "arbitrary endpoint/scope/degenerate/duplicate rows changed"
  let first : Geometry Scope := ⟨scope 0,[(0,2)]⟩
  let wrong : Geometry Scope := ⟨scope 1,[(0,2)]⟩
  let rejected := Sharing.check (fun _ : Nat => first) [0] (fun _ => 0) #[wrong]
  check rejected.isNone "different full geometry was shared"
  let rejected := Sharing.check (fun _ : Nat => first) [0] (fun _ => 1) #[first]
  check rejected.isNone "out-of-range geometry class accepted"
  let shape : Eggshell.Plugin.SharedRangeAdapter.UnitShape := {family := 0,ranges := [(0,2),(2,4)]}
  let product : Array Eggshell.Plugin.SharedRangeAdapter.ServiceUnit := #[{shape}]
  let coordinate : Coordinate Nat := ⟨0,1,3⟩
  check ((ProductRangeIncidence.base product).neighbors coordinate |>.isEmpty)
    "single-interval predicate incorrectly merged adjacent ranges"
  check (((ProductRangeIncidence.union product).neighbors coordinate).map Fin.val == [0]) "union coverage lost an adjacent span"
  letI : Hashable Scope := ⟨fun _ => 0⟩
  letI : Hashable Nat := ⟨fun _ => 0⟩
  match compileSharing geometries units with
  | none => throw (IO.userError "colliding range controls rejected")
  | some collision => do
    let colliding : Dataset := ⟨units,geometries,collision,requests++requests⟩
    check (reference colliding == indexed colliding) "hash collision lost scope or query order"
    return 6

def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let [path] := args | throw (IO.userError "range benchmark output required")
  let output : System.FilePath := path
  check (!(← output.pathExists)) "preserve range benchmark evidence"
  let controlChecks ← controls
  let mut cases := #[]
  for (name,scopes,count,width,degree,requests) in [
      ("empty",1,0,1,0,0),("small",4,32,16,3,64),("balanced",46,10637,144,3,17414),
      ("single-scope",1,2048,4096,3,8192),("dense",1,128,1,3,4096),("wide",1,128,64,64,4096)] do
    let began ← IO.monoNanosNow
    let data ← make scopes count width degree requests
    let input ← IO.mkRef data
    let prepareUs := ((← IO.monoNanosNow)-began)/1000
    let mut trials := #[]
    for round in [:3] do
      let (a,b) ← if round%2 == 0 then do
        let a ← measured reference input
        let b ← measured indexed input
        pure (a,b)
      else do
        let b ← measured indexed input
        let a ← measured reference input
        pure (a,b)
      check (a.1 == b.1) "range projection changed complete ordered rows and weights"
      trials := trials.push (Json.mkObj [("referenceUs",toJson a.2),("indexedUs",toJson b.2),("allOrderedRowsEqual",toJson true)])
    cases := cases.push (Json.mkObj [("case",toJson name),("units",toJson count),("requests",toJson requests),
      ("geometryClasses",toJson data.sharing.classes.size),("wholeFixturePreparationUs",toJson prepareUs),("trials",toJson trials)])
  IO.FS.writeFile output (Json.mkObj [("cases",toJson cases),("controlComparisons",toJson controlChecks),
    ("allQueriesUseUnpublishedEndpoints",toJson true),("scopeIncludesDbOwnerFingerprint",toJson true),
    ("syntheticOnly",toJson true),("productPredicateProofs",toJson true),("actualHookCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),
    ("answeringModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),("adopted",toJson false)]).compress
end RangeIncidenceBench
def main := RangeIncidenceBench.main
